data.name: Muharir
data.gender_notes: Muharir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who awakens or stirs up, often used to describe the Prophet Muhammad's role in guiding people to the truth. The name Muharir carries the meaning “The Awakener” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muharir usually hope their child will grow to embody the awakener and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To awaken and guide others to the truth.
data.etymology: Muharir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Awakener.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muharir total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: محرير
in_arabic.meaning: الذي يحرر الناس من الظلم و الجور
in_arabic.long_meaning: المحرر هو الشخص الذي يحرر الناس من الظلم و الجور، و يطلق على من يقوم بتحرير العبيد و المظلومين. و هو اسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معنى الحرية و التحرير.

in_urdu.name: محرر
in_urdu.meaning: جو لوگوں کو ظلم سے آزاد کرے
in_urdu.long_meaning: محرر وہ شخص ہے جو لوگوں کو ظلم و ستم سے آزاد کرتا ہے، خصوصاً وہ جو غلاموں اور مظلوموں کو تحریر کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام آزادی اور تحریر کے معنی رکھتا ہے جو اسلامی تعلیمات میں بہت اہم ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: मुहरिर
in_hindi.meaning: जो लोगों को अन्याय से मुक्त करे
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुहरिर वह व्यक्ति है जो लोगों को अन्याय और अत्याचार से मुक्त करता है, विशेष रूप से वह जो दासों और पीड़ितों को आजाद कराता है। यह नाम स्वतंत्रता और मुक्ति के अर्थ रखता है जो इस्लामी शिक्षाओं में महत्वपूर्ण हैं।

in_pashto.name: محرر
in_pashto.meaning: چې کسان د ظلم څخه ازاد کړي
in_pashto.long_meaning: محرر هغه څوک دی چې کسان د ظلم او ستم څخه ازاد کړي، په ځانګړي ډول هغه څوک چې غلامان او مظلومان آزاديږي. دا نوم د آزادۍ او تحرير معنی لري چې په اسلامي ښوونو کې ډېر مهم دي.

in_english.name: Muharir
in_english.meaning: one who frees people from oppression and injustice
in_english.long_meaning: Muharir is a name that signifies a person who liberates others from oppression, injustice, and tyranny. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'ḥ-r-r' which means 'to free' or 'to liberate', this name is often associated with the act of freeing slaves or the oppressed. In Islamic tradition, it holds significant spiritual and cultural importance as it reflects the values of justice, compassion, and freedom.
